headline: Get Melloblum
title: How to Get Melloblum in Aniimo | Budsquire Journey and Rose | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Melloblum is the end of the Budsquire line, and you find it in Rosetower Woods. First, complete the Journey called Flowers and Thorns. Then your Budsquire must be at least level twenty seven, and its personality must contain Faithful. Finally, get a Stamen of Cubbo's Rose. Check the personality first, because Budsquire can also become Thornblade. Which one are you going for? Comment below!
description: Melloblum evolves from Budsquire at level 27 with a Faithful personality, after the Journey Flowers and Thorns, using a Stamen of Cubbo's Rose.
